summary: Tested the PC-AP cargo/fee change. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass. /api/pix/generate returns valor 200 for cargo_codigo '1' and '01' and 150 for '2', and the BRCode contains 5406200.00 or 5406150.00. With cpf only, it falls back to the cargo of the inscription. /api/track/registration stores valor and taxa per cargo; the valor sent by the client is ignored. /api/inscricao/resumo/{cpf} and /api/admin/inscriptions return 200 or 150 correctly. Frontend E2E at 1920px for both cargos: termos -> inscricao -> dados-inscricao -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada -> pagamento-pix -> minhas-inscricoes. No POLO select and no 'Polo' text. #VAGA is enabled and has 2 options (1/200.00, 2/150.00), labelled 'Cargo'. 'Cargo Escolhido' appears on confirmacao, realizada and pix. Delegado shows R$ 200,00 everywhere and its 158-char Pix code contains 5406200.00. Oficial Investigador shows R$ 150,00 and its code contains 5406150.00. The other value never appears. The chosen cargo is restored when the user goes back to dados-inscricao (VAGA=1). minhas-inscricoes shows 'Cargo' and the correct value. No JS page errors. All test records were deleted from inscricoes, cadastros, registrations and pix_* collections.

minor.issue: valor_unit is still the constant VALOR_INSCRICAO=150 and does not depend on the cargo. cpf_to_valor is keyed by CPF only, so a CPF with both cargos is counted once, using the value of whichever document is read last. This only affects display.
valor_inscricao in the DB is still 225.0 (stale). Pix ignores it, but the admin UI may show it.

issues: 'Estado da Prova' shows 'São Paulo' and the city shows AMERICANA/SP although the contest is in Amapá. The user said exam cities will be sent later, so this is noted only.

action_items: Optional: make KPI valor_unit/settings valor_inscricao consistent with per-cargo fees
Later: update UF_PROVA/MUNICIPIO_PROVA to Amapá cities when the user provides them
critical_code_review_comments: pix/generate: the cargo_codigo from the client takes precedence over the cargo stored in the inscription. That is fine because both prices are public, but a client can choose the cheaper cargo's Pix for a Delegado inscription. Consider preferring the stored inscription cargo when cpf and cargo do not match.
admin_routes.py is 1983 lines and should be split.
Legacy test files (test_valor_150.py, test_taxa_120.py) are outdated: they assert 150 for cargo '03' and overwrite pix_key settings. Delete them or update them.
seed_data_creation: Test CPFs 52998224725 (cargo 1) and 11144477735 (cargo 2) were created and then deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run the flow, generically fill the required selects and radios on inscricao, use DOC_TIPO=RG with 1x1 PNG uploads, then select [data-testid=select-vaga] '1' or '2'. On dados-inscricao, also check the checkboxes that have no id (the termo) before clicking btn-cadastrar. Then click btn-confirmar-inscricao to reach inscricao-realizada. Labels are uppercased with CSS, so compare text case-insensitively. Note that 'CONCURSO' contains 'CURSO'. Do not change admin pix_key: it is configured as real data.
